name: phylo-tree
title: Phylo Tree
description: A phylogenetic tree from Newick: rectangular or circular, phylogram or cladogram, with rounded elbows and the path to every leaf lit from the node you point at. Support values as numbers or dots above a threshold, shaded clades named by their taxa, clades folded into triangles, aligned labels, a scale bar or a time axis, and keyboard walking. parseNewick, toNewick, ladderize, reroot, distances (p or Jukes–Cantor) and neighborJoining build trees from your own data.
